name: habit-tracker-monorepo
description: Habit Tracker multiplataforma (PC + movil) con sistema de presion y modulo universitario

scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @habit/server" "npm run dev -w @habit/web"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @habit/server
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @habit/web
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @habit/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @habit/core && npm run typecheck -w @habit/web
